title: Green Alien Portrait
description: A green-skinned alien with an elongated head, sharp facial features, and glowing red eyes stares directly forward. The figure is centered in a layered, abstract composition with swirling patterns, faded text fragments, and overlapping translucent elements in the background.
prompt: A striking portrait of a green-skinned alien with an elongated smooth head, high cheekbones, narrow chin, and piercing red eyes with black pupils. The creature has subtle facial ridges and a serious expression, centered in the frame. The background consists of layered abstract elements including swirling blue and black patterns, faded overlapping text fragments, and warm orange-red tones creating depth and mystery.
